tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

/na mo/ gang zhig gzhi bdag la sogs pa// phrag dog zhi phyir bsang ba'i thabs// 'o ma can shing sna tshogs par// phye mar spos sman btab pa yi// dud pa ches cher btang nas ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ */ don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas bden pa'i gtso| |chags dang bral ba dam chos bden pa'i mchog /phyir mi ldog pa dge 'dun bden pa'i mchog /bla ma yi dam rtsa gsum bden pa'i mchog |ma sring mkha' 'gro dam can bden pa'i mchog /bslu med rgyu 'bras gshis babs bden pa'i mchog /bden pa'i ngag la mgron rigs kun nyon cig /hūm̐ */ sna tshogs rtsi shing dud pa la// sman spos phye mar bcud du bran// 'dod yon sna tshogs yid kyis sprul// kun gyi dgyes skong dga' ston la// rnam bzhi'i mgron rnams spyan 'dren gshegs// bsang mchod dud sprin dkrigs pa las// 'dod yon sna tshogs char du 'bab// dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams kyi// spyan sngar dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul// mgon po yon tan mgron rnams kyi| |thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas su 'bul// rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la// rang rang dgyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul// lan chags bu lon mgron rnams la// so sor tshim pa'i 'dod yon bsngo// khyad par sa phyogs yul phyogs 'di'i// lha klu gzhi bdag gnas bdag tshogs// pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i tshogs rnams gnas 'dir gshegs// bsang mchod dud sprin 'dod yon 'di// bltas pa tsam gyis mig tshim zhing*// nyan pa tsam gyis rna ba tshim// snom pa tsam gyis sna yang tshim*// myang ba tsam gyis lce tshim la// reg pa tsam gyis lus tshim zhing*//

dran pa tsam gyis yid tshim pa'i// 'dod yon dga' ston 'di bzhes la// bdag cag mi nor bcas pa'i tshogs*// bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa dang*// lus sems bde bar longs spyod cing*// nad 'tshe'i bgegs dang bral nas kyang*// 'dod don 'grub pa'i grogs gyis shig /kyai/ rnal 'byor bdag gi srung ma dang*// dgra lha pho lha yul gyi lha// srog lha zhang lha ma lha dang*// ban bon srung ma bang lha sogs// lha srin sde brgyad pho mo klu// dbu 'phang dgung dang mnyam par bstod// gsol lo mchod do phrin las sgrubs// khyed rnams bdag dang lus grib ltar// mi 'bral 'grogs shing stongs grogs mdzod// stong gsum phyogs bcu'i phun tshogs kun// de ring bdag gis g.yang du len// phywa bskor g.yang bskyil dpal du 'bar| |rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog/ hūm̐ */ nga ni sngags 'chang thugs rdo rje// nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// nga ni zhe sdang rdo rje ste// gal te 'di las khyod 'gal na| |rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi// sbyor ba drag po mi bzad pas// nyams pa'i gzhi bdag las ngan de'i// lus kyi phung po dum bur gtub// mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru gtong*// don snying dmar po rngam zas bgyid// snying khrag dwangs ma hub kyis 'thung*// dbang po rnam lnga phye mar gtong*// rnam shes rdo rje'i dmyal bar sreg /de 'dra'i 'jigs par cher soms la// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /ya mān+ta ka ma hā ri ṣi ma hā sa ma ya i dan+te na rak+kan/ zhes rang nyid sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjer mos pa'i nga rgyal brtan pos bsgrag na lha srin sde brgyad gang yang mi nyan pa dang mi 'dus pa mi srid de/ sde brgyad thams cad sngags 'chang nga'i 'bangs dang pho nyar ma gyur pa gang yang med pas so// zhes so so'i yul gyi gzhi bdag la rngan sbyin dam brdar du/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rig sngags kyi mthu grub pa chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o//
